item.title: Thailand: Tech and Work Learning to Build a Smart Workforce
item.description: MHESI enhances its technological and innovation ecosystem by upgrading Mahidol University’s Power Electronics Laboratory and promoting work-integrated education to prepare a future-ready workforce.

item.title: Australia: CSIRO Pioneering Responsible AI Adoption
item.description: CSIRO is leading Australia’s responsible AI adoption by promoting ethical, transparent, safe and accountable AI practices across industries and the public sector while actively supporting innovation, collaboration and trust.

item.title: Indonesia: Digital Platforms to Elevate Global Literary Presence
item.description: Indonesia has launched the Read Indonesia digital platform to leverage technology, promoting its literature globally, connecting authors, publishers and readers while enhancing cultural diplomacy and heritage appreciation.

item.title: Hong Kong: Strengthening Intellectual Property Capabilities
item.description: Hong Kong is strengthening its innovation ecosystem by launching a new platform that enhances intellectual property capabilities and supports the effective commercialisation of research and technology applications.

item.title: Vietnam: Building a Secure, Resilient E-Commerce Market
item.description: Vietnam’s e-commerce market is rapidly growing and showing strong resilience, with authorities actively strengthening oversight to effectively combat counterfeit goods and protect consumers in the digital economy.

item.title: Malaysia: Helping Rural Youth Explore Industry 4.0 Careers
item.description: Malaysia’s investment promotion agency is connecting rural youth with advanced manufacturing by showcasing how automation, digital systems and Industry 4.0 technologies are shaping future industrial skills and careers.

item.title: India: AI Skilling to Build a Future-Ready Workforce
item.description: India is advancing AI skilling through MSDE and the IndiaAI Mission, fostering collaboration across government, industry and academia to build a future-ready workforce for an inclusive, AI-enabled Viksit Bharat.

item.title: Singapore: Milestones and Momentum of a Smart Nation
item.description: Singapore’s Smart Nation initiative combines decades of digital milestones, cutting-edge infrastructure and RIE2030 innovation strategies to strengthen connectivity, talent and global competitiveness.

item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU Pioneers AI for Research, Education and Industry
item.description: PolyU is advancing AI-powered research, literature analysis and human-robot collaboration, positioning Hong Kong as a global hub for innovation and human-centric development.

item.title: Vietnam: Robust AML Framework in the Digital Finance Era
item.description: Vietnam is strengthening its anti-money laundering framework to address growing financial risks from digital assets and new investment channels as it advances the development of an international financial centre.
